medium.density_basis: assumed reference air; not measured environmental conditions

conventions.surface_normals: Canonical branches outward from front air; final exterior BEM must choose and declare solver-required orientation.
conventions.source_motion: Rigid translation along each motion_into_front_air; normal velocity varies with cone normal. Nominal Sd is the projected area, not sloping area.
conventions.flow: Positive volume velocity INTO each local air domain. Coupled interfaces have continuous pressure and equal/opposite outward normal velocity.
conventions.entry_interfaces: Diagnostic branch caps only. Omit them from the connected whole-air BEM boundary.
conventions.mouth: Open to the same exterior fluid for BEM. A tagged cap exists only for FEM coupled termination; never set zero pressure by default.

fem_coupling_interface.kind: artificial FEM coupling plane before tangent rollover
fem_coupling_interface.selection: Last forward station with centered-secant tangent at most 75 degrees from +Z
fem_coupling_interface.required_exterior: The downstream horn wall, complete rollover and enclosure must remain in the coupled exterior. A prescribed pressure-release cap is not an equivalent radiation load.

domains.coupled_at: Mouth is open; same fluid as all front passages

tube.note: Canonical length includes the 3 mm allowance; the horn-cut perimeter is curved so actual wall lengths vary. Do not add this tube again to a matrix that already includes the full branch.

volumes.note: Canonical branch volume is bounded by the exact triangles and declared diagnostic entry fan. Editor volume uses a flat nominal neck and analytical cone; these are distinct estimates.

rear.note: The rear compliance is shared by all driver motors. External enclosure surface is included for radiation; its interior is not a solved acoustic rear volume.

mesh_request.convergence: Density is an initial request, not a validated band limit. Refine independently and compare complex acoustic results.

canonical_warnings: Contour insert is a geometry and volume study. Its narrow-gap flow and actual diaphragm clearance are outside the acoustic model.

limitations: Rigid walls and lossless geometric boundary; viscothermal gap losses are not provided.
Rear air remains a shared lumped compliance; cone back faces are not separate external sources.
Source voltages need motor/rear-load coupling; uniform assigned velocity alone is not a voltage-driven loudspeaker prediction.
Proprietary AKABAK/ABEC import and solve are not established by this extraction.
Assembly, global self-intersections and mesh quality require native validation.
